editorial:
If you're looking for a charming animated adventure that feels like a bedtime story come to life, Mune: Guardian of the Moon is a delightful pick. The story follows Mune, a small faun who unexpectedly becomes the Guardian of the Moon, even though he has no idea what he's doing. When an accident puts both the Moon and the Sun in danger, a corrupt titan named Necross tries to steal the Sun for himself, throwing the balance of night and day into chaos. Along the way, Mune teams up with Glim, a sweet wax-child, and Sohone, a brave warrior who becomes the Sun Guardian. Together, they set off on a colorful journey to recover the Sun and restore the Moon to its rightful place in the sky. The world is imaginative, the characters are lovable, and the whole thing has a warm, dreamy feel that kids and adults can enjoy together.

The animation is gorgeous, with glowing night skies and rich fantasy landscapes that really pop on screen. The pacing moves along nicely, mixing humor, heart, and a few tense moments without ever feeling too heavy. Some of the plot beats are a little predictable, and younger viewers might find a few scenes slightly scary, but overall it's a fun, family-friendly ride. If you love animated fantasy like Song of the Sea or The Secret World of Arrietty, this one is worth your time. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final act, Mune and his friends confront Necross to reclaim the Sun and fix the Moon. Mune finally embraces his role as Guardian, using his unique connection to the Moon to help restore balance. Glim's wax body becomes a key part of the plan, and Sohone proves his bravery as the Sun Guardian. In the end, Necross is defeated, the Sun and Moon return to their proper places, and day and night are balanced once more. Mune accepts his destiny, and the world is safe again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves animated fantasy adventures and family-friendly stories.
